title: Game 7, Midway Through the Third
setup: Game 7 of the 2019 first round, Golden Knights against the Sharks. Vegas leads 3-0 midway through the third period. The officials call a penalty on Vegas's Cody Eakin for cross-checking.
question: What penalty do the officials assess?
options: A five-minute major and a game misconduct on Eakin.
A penalty shot for San Jose.
ruling: The officials gave Eakin a five-minute major for cross-checking plus a game misconduct. The Sharks scored four power-play goals and won 5-4 in overtime. According to Vegas GM George McPhee, the league reached out and apologized to the Golden Knights afterward.
rulebookNote: The source states the penalty length (five minutes) and the apology, as reported by McPhee. It does not say whether the call could be reviewed.
